resources.string: The app runs in full-screen mode and is controlled via touchscreen, without interacting with the PipBoy hardware.
The app\'s display area is set manually. The app is controlled by the PipBoy 2000 hardware. Touchscreen control is still available, but optional.
Insert your phone into the PipBoy case.
Adjust the display area to fit the PipBoy screen.

PipBoy needs Bluetooth and location permissions (to scan for and connect to the case hardware) and notification permission (background connection to the case shows a persistent connection-status notification). The system usually asks for these on its own \u2014 the button below is only needed if the system dialog doesn\'t appear for some reason.
Scanning\u2026 Make sure the PipBoy case is powered on and nearby.
Found %1$d device(s). Select your PipBoy from the list.
Nothing found. Check the case\'s power and tap \"Scan Again\".
Couldn\'t start scanning, please try again.
While the PipBoy is off, this screen stays black. To turn on the PipBoy, press POWER.
Tap the Vault Boy figure to reset
"Hooray, you\'re healthy!\nIf you get wounded, press a button.\nYou can tap the Vault Boy\'s body to mark where you got hit."
Strength is a measure of your raw physical power. It affects how much you can carry, the power of all melee attacks, and your effectiveness with many heavy weapons.
A high Perception grants a bonus to the Explosives, Lockpick and Energy Weapons skills, and determines when red compass markings appear (which indicate threats).
Endurance is a measure of your overall physical fitness. A high Endurance gives bonuses to health, environmental resistances, and the Survival and Unarmed skills.
"Having a high Charisma will improve people's disposition toward you, and give bonuses to both the Barter and Speech skills."
"Intelligence affects the Science, Repair and medicine skills. The higher your Intelligence, the more Skill Points you'll be able to distribute when you level up."
Agility affects your Guns and Sneak skills, and the number of Action Points available for V.A.T.S.
Raising your Luck will raise all of your skills a little. Having a high Luck will also improve your critical chance with all weapons.
The Barter skill affects the prices you get for buying and selling items. In general, the higher your Barter skill, the lower your prices on purchased items.
The Big Guns skill determines your combat effectiveness with all oversized weapons such as the Fat Man, Missile Launcher, Flamer, Minigun and Gatling Laser.
The Energy Weapons skill determines your effectiveness with any weapon that uses Small Energy Cells, Micro Fusion Cells, EC Packs, or Flamer Fuel as ammunition.
The Explosives skill determines the ease of disarming any hostile mines and the effectiveness of any explosive weapon (all mines, all grenades, Missile Launcher, Fat Man, etc.).
The Lockpick skill is used to open locked doors and containers.
"The Medicine skill determines how many hit points you'll replenish upon using a Stimpak, and the effectiveness of Rad-X and RadAway."
The Melee Weapons skill determines your effectiveness with any melee weapon, from the simple lead pipe all the way up to the high-tech Super Sledge.
The Repair skill allows you to maintain your weapons and apparel. In addition, Repair allows you to create items and Guns ammunition at reloading benches.
The Science skill represents your combined scientific knowledge, and is primarily used to hack restricted computer terminals. It can also be used to recycle Energy Weapon ammunition at workbenches.
The Small Guns determines your effectiveness with all conventional projectile weapons, such as 10mm pistol, BB Gun, Assault Rifle, and Combat Shotgun.
"The higher your Sneak skill, the easier it is to remain undetected, steal an item, or pick someone's pocket. Successfully attacking while undetected grants an automatic critical hit."
The Speech skill governs how much you can influence someone through dialogue, and gain access to information they might otherwise not want to share.
The Unarmed skill is used for fighting without a weapon, or with weapons designed for hand-to-hand combat, like Brass Knuckles, Power Fists, and Displacer Gloves.
With the Action Boy perk, you gain an additional 25 Action Points to use in V.A.T.S.
With the Action Girl perk, you gain an additional 25 Action Points to use in V.A.T.S.
With the Adamantium Skeleton perk, your limbs only receive 50% of the damage they normally would.
At the first rank of this perk, animals simply won\'t attack. At the second rank, they will actually come to your aid in combat, but never against another animal.
Reduce the AP Cost of Unarmed Attacks in VATS
With the Better Criticals perk, you gain a 50% damage bonus every time a critical hit is scored on an opponent.
While Arcade is a companion, the player regains more health from all sources.
In combat, you do 10% extra damage against male opponents. Outside of combat, you sometimes receive unique dialogue options when dealing with the opposite sex.
With the Bloody Mess perk, characters and creatures you kill will often explode into a red, gut-ridden, eyeball-strewn paste. Fun! Oh, and you\'ll do 5% more damage with all weapons.
The flamer that burns twice as bright burns half as long. All weapons have +3% chance to Critical Hit, but equipment condition decays 15% faster.

With the Cannibal perk, when you\'re in Sneak mode, you gain the option to eat a corpse to regain Health. But every time you feed, you lose Karma, and if the act is witnessed, it is considered a crime against nature.
You don\'t fool around with fancy trick shots. Straight to the midsection and down they go. In V.A.T.S., you do an additional 15% damage with attacks targeting the torso.
With the Chemist perk, any chems you take last twice as long.
Having the Chem Resistant perk means you\'re 50% less likely to develop an addiction to chems, like Psycho or Jet.
In combat, you do +10% damage against female opponents. Outside of combat, you\'ll sometimes have access to unique dialogue options when dealing with the same sex.
This perk greatly improves your interactions with children, usually in the form of unique dialogue options.
While using a rifle (or similar two-handed weapon), your accuracy in V.A.T.S. is significantly increased.
With the Comprehension perk, you gain one additional skill point whenever a skill book is read.
With Concentrated Fire, your accuracy to hit any body part in V.A.T.S. increases slightly with each subsequent hit on that body part.
In combat, you do +10% damage against male opponents. Outside of combat, you\'ll sometimes have access to unique dialogue options when dealing with the same sex.

Once you have the Contract Killer perk, any good character you kill will have an ear on their corpse. This ear can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and negative Karma.
You do 25% more damage when using any revolver, lever-action firearm, dynamite, knife, or hatchet.
You\'ve made permanent enhancements to your body! The Cyborg perk instantly adds +10% to your Damage, Poison, and Radiation Resistances, and 10 points to the Energy Weapons skill.
With each rank of this perk, all of your explosive weapons do an additional 20% damage.
Something about your presence dampens others\' desires to exceed. Any enemy\'s chance of getting critical hits on you is reduced by 50%.
With the Educated perk, you gain two more skill points every time you advance in level. This perk is best taken early on, to maximize its effectiveness.
Your prefrontal cortex has been enhanced with the Empathy Synthesizer, increasing your Charisma by 1.
While ED-E is a companion, the player can detect enemies at an increased range. Additionally, enemies will appear on the player\'s compass and can be targeted in V.A.T.S. even when cloaked.
With the Entomologist perk, you do an additional +50% damage every time you attack a mutated insect, like the radroach, giant ant, or radscorpion.
When you choose the Explorer perk, every location in the world is revealed on your map. So get out there and explore!
With the Fast Metabolism perk, you gain a 20% Health bonus when using Stimpaks.
While using Guns and Energy Weapons, you fire 20% more quickly but your shots are 20% less accurate.
The power of your personality inspires die-hard loyalty from your followers. When you drop below 50% health, your companions temporarily gain much greater resistance to damage.
With the Finesse perk, you have a higher chance to score a critical hit on an opponent in combat, equivalent to 5 extra points of Luck.
With the Fortune Finder perk, you\'ll find considerably more Nuka-Cola caps in containers than you normally would.
While wearing any type of glasses, you have +1 PER. Without glasses, you have -1 PER.
You are a true friend of the night. Your eyes adapt quickly to low-light conditions indoors and when darkness falls across the post-nuclear wasteland.
While Raul is a companion, the Condition of weapons and armor decays 75% slower.

With Ghastly Scavenger, when you\'re in Sneak mode, you gain the option to eat a Super Mutant or Feral Ghoul corpse to regain Health. Every time you feed, you lose Karma, and if the act is witnessed, it is considered a crime against nature.

You\'re Good Natured at heart, more prone to solving problems with your mind than violence. You gain +5 to Barter, Medicine, Repair, Science, and Speech, but have -5 to Energy Weapons, Explosives, Guns, Melee Weapons, and Unarmed.
If you kill a target while in V.A.T.S., all of your Action Points are restored upon exiting V.A.T.S.
While using a pistol (or similar one-handed weapon), your accuracy in V.A.T.S. is significantly increased.
You are obsessed with using and maintaining a wide variety of conventional firearms. With each rank of the Gun Nut perk, you gain an additional 5 points to the Small Guns and Repair skills.

You know your way around a reloading bench and don\'t let good brass and hulls go to waste. When you use Guns, you are more likely to recover cases and hulls. You also have all hand load recipes unlocked at any of the wasteland\'s reloading benches.
Your melee and unarmed attacks do more damage, but less critical hit damage.
The Here and Now perk immediately grants an additional experience level, complete with all the advantages that brings.
Your extensive familiarity with Explosives allows you to ignore a portion of their damage. Your Damage Threshold is increased by 25 against any and all Explosives -- even your own.
In combat, you do +75% Critical Damage against animals and mutated animals.
Your muscle mass has been enhanced with the Hypertrophy Accelerator, increasing your Strength by 1.
With the impartial mediation perk, you gain an extra 30 points to your Speech skill so long as you maintain a neutral Karma level.
The Infiltrator perk gives you a second attempt at a lock that you previously broke while trying to force it.
With the Intense Training perk, you can put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes.
With the Iron Fist perk, you do an additional 5 points of Unarmed damage per rank.

You possess the amazing ability to repair any item using a roughly similar item. Fix a trail carbine with a hunting rifle, a Plasma Defender with a laser pistol, or even power armor with metal armor. How does it work? Nobody knows... except you.
You have +10 Action Points but your reckless nature causes you to have -2 Damage Threshold.

By relying on the dirty unarmed fighting tricks of the Great Khans, you can throw dust into the eyes of your enemies, temporarily stunning them. Perform a Power Attack while moving left or right to execute the Khan Trick.
In combat, you do +10% damage against female opponents. Outside of combat, you\'ll sometimes have access to unique dialogue options when dealing with the opposite sex.
From the humble Laser Pistol to the mighty Gatling Laser, you do +15% damage and have +10% chance to critically hit with any laser weapon.

Once you have the Lawbringer perk, any evil character you kill will have a finger on their corpse. This finger can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and positive Karma.
With the Lead Belly perk, you take 50% less radiation every time you drink from an irradiated water source.
Caesar\'s elite cadre of bodyguards, the legendary praetorians, use an aggressive Legion Assault to brutalize enemies. Perform a Power Attack while running forward to execute the Legion Assault.
With the Life Giver perk, you gain an additional 30 Hit Points.
With the Light Step perk, you\'ll never set off an enemy\'s mines or floor-based traps.
Just like dear old Dad, you’ve devoted your time to intellectual pursuits. You gain an additional 5 points to both the Science and Medicine skills.
Years as the Vault little league MVP have honed your hitting and throwing. With every rank, you gain 5 points of Melee Weapons skill and 5 points of Explosives skill.
Living Anatomy allows you to see the health and Damage Threshold of any target. It also gives you a +5% bonus to damage against humans and non-feral ghouls.
Your cerebral cortex has been enhanced with the Logic Co-Processor, increasing your Intelligence by 1.
You have learned how to pack mountains of gear for the long haul. Being over-encumbered no longer prevents you from using fast travel.
From frag grenades to throwing spears, you can throw weapons 30% faster at the cost of 25% less range
When you take the Master Trader perk, the price of every item you buy from a vendor is reduced by 25%.
You are able to optimize your Pip-Boy\'s V.A.T.S. logic, reducing all AP costs by 10%.
Foes killed by your Energy Weapons emit a corona of harmful energy.
Just when your enemies think they have the upper hand, Miss Fortune appears to turn their world upside down. Appearing only in V.A.T.S., she has the ability to snatch defeat from the jaws of victory.
With the Mister Sandman perk, when you\'re in Sneak mode, you gain the option to silently kill any human or Ghoul while they\'re sleeping. And, all Mister Sandman kills earn bonus XP.
You are more likely to cause Critical Hits in combat if you have this Perk. Each level of More Criticals will get you a +5% chance to cause a critical hit. This is a good thing.
Advanced technology from the Commonwealth has increased your reaction speed, giving you a higher chance to hit in V.A.T.S.
This perk allows you to regain health by consuming Bloodpacks.
You\'ve been exposed to Harold\'s mutation and your skin is now as hard as tree bark. As a result, you\'ve gained a permanent +5% to Damage Resistance.

Gives you your own personal guardian angel... armed with a fully loaded .44 Magnum. With this perk, the Mysterious Stranger appears occasionally in V.A.T.S. mode to lend a hand, with deadly efficiency.
Your skin has been toughened by the NEMEAN Sub-Dermal Armor, increasing your total Damage Threshold by 4.
You\'ve been pushed around long enough! With the Nerd Rage perk, your Strength is raised to 10 and you gain 15 points to Damage Threshold whenever your Health drops to 20% or below.

When the sun is down, a Night Person gains +2 to both Intelligence and Perception (up to a maximum of 10). This perk directly affects your \'internal clock\' and remains active both inside and outside.

The Ninja perk grants you the power of the fabled shadow warriors. When attacking, you gain a +15% critical chance on all Melee and Unarmed attacks. Additionally, Sneak attack criticals do 25% more damage than normal.
Your nervous system has been enhanced with the Nociception Regulator, increasing your Endurance by 1.
Your optic nerve has been enhanced with the Optics Enhancer, increasing your Perception by 1.
You have learned the value of careful packing. Items with a weight of 2 or less weigh half as much for you.

With Paralyzing Palm, you will sometimes perform a special V.A.T.S. palm strike that paralyzes your opponent for 30 seconds. Note that in order to perform the Paralyzing Palm, you must be completely unarmed.
Your regenerative ability has been enhanced by the PHOENIX Monocyte Breeder implant, causing you to slowly regenerate lost hit points.
Piercing Strike makes all of your Unarmed and Melee Weapons (including thrown) negate 15 points of Damage Threshold on the target.
You\'re just so excited about plasma that you can\'t (magnetically) contain yourself! The AP costs for all plasma weapons (including Plasma Grenades) are reduced by 20%.
Your frontal lobe has been enhanced with the Probability Calculator, increasing your Luck by 1.
As a purifier of the wasteland, you do +50% damage with Melee and Unarmed weapons against Centaurs, Nightstalkers, Spore Plants, Spore Carriers, Deathclaws, Super Mutants, and Feral Ghouls.
With the Pyromaniac perk, you do +50% damage with fire-based weapons, like the Flamer and Shishkebab.
Quick Draw makes all of your weapon equipping and holstering 50% faster.
You truly are a rad child. As you go through the increasingly devastating stages of radiation sickness, you will regenerate more and more health.
Rad Resistance allows you to -- what else? -- resist radiation. This perk grants an additional 25% to Radiation Resistance.
When caught without their weapons, NCR\'s rangers rely on the Ranger Takedown to quickly incapacitate opponents. Perform a Power Attack while moving backwards to execute a Ranger Takedown.
Rapid Reload makes all of your weapon reloads 25% faster than normal.
Your central nervous node has been enhanced with the Reflex Booster, increasing your Agility by 1.
While Raul is a companion, the Condition of weapons and armor decays more slowly.
With the Retention perk, the bonuses granted by skill magazines last three times as long.
With the Robotics Expert perk, you do an additional 25% damage to any robot. Also, sneaking up on a hostile robot undetected and deactivating it will put that robot into a permanent shutdown state.
The Run \'n Gun perk reduces accuracy penalties with one-handed Guns and Energy Weapons while walking or running.
Take the Scoundrel perk, and you can use your wily charms to influence people -- each rank raises your Speech and Barter skills by 5 points.
While Veronica is a companion, the player can craft Workbench items through Veronica\'s dialogue.

Scribes in the Brotherhood of Steel are often not well-trained in the combat use of the high-tech gear employed by Paladins. They rely on unarmed defensive moves like the Scribe Counter to keep enemies at bay. Perform a standard attack out of a block hit reaction to execute a Scribe Counter.
With the Scrounger perk, you\'ll find considerably more ammunition in containers than you normally would.
While Rex is a companion, unequipped chems, firearms, and ammunition within a short distance are highlighted when you zoom the camera.
With this perk, your precision with a scattergun is something to behold. When using shotguns, regardless of ammunition used, you ignore an additional 10 points of a target\'s Damage Threshold.
With the Silent Running perk, running no longer factors into a successful sneak attempt.
You are obsessed with really big weapons. With each rank of this perk, you gain an additional 15 points to the Big Guns skill.
The slayer walks the earth! The speed of all Melee Weapons and Unarmed attacks is increased by 30%.
Due to your small size, you have +1 Agility but your limbs are more easily crippled (25% extra limb damage).
With the Sniper perk, your chance to hit an opponent\'s head in V.A.T.S. is significantly increased.
With the Solar Powered perk, you gain an additional 2 points to Strength when in direct sunlight, and slowly regenerate lost Health.
When you\'re deep in enemy territory, you just start chucking grenades and hope for the best. All Explosives have a 25% larger area of effect when they detonate.
While Boone is a companion, hostile targets are highlighted whenever the player is actively aiming.
Your attacks do much less damage to companions, allowing you to liberally spray an area with reckless abandon.
While Lily is a companion, the duration of Stealth Boys is increased by 200% and all Sneak Attack Critical Hits do an additional 10% damage.
You gain +5 Damage Threshold against all Melee Weapons and Unarmed attacks and cannot be knocked down in combat.
With this perk, you can carry an additional 50 lbs. of equipment.
All Melee Weapons (except thrown) and Unarmed attacks have a chance of knocking your target down.
You are a master of the outdoors. This Perk confers the ability to survive in hostile environments. You get a +20% bonus to Outdoorsman for survival purposes, for each level of this Perk.
+2% Poison and Radiation Resistance, +5 HP, +2 Medicine, +2 Science, +2% DR, +2 Sneak, +2 Speech, +1% Critical Chance
+4% Poison and Radiation Resistance, +10 HP, +4 Medicine, +4 Science, +4% DR, +4 Sneak, +4 Speech, +2% Critical Chance
+6% Poison and Radiation Resistance, +15 HP, +6 Medicine, +6 Science, +6% DR, +6 Sneak, +6 Speech, +3% Critical Chance
With each level of Swift Learner your character will gain an additional +10% to experience whenever Experience Points are earned.
The Tag! perk allows you to select a fourth skill to be a Tag skill, which instantly raises it by fifteen points.
In some conversations, you gain the ability to initiate combat while terrifying a mob of opponents, sending them fleeing away for safety.
Up close and personal, that\'s how you like it. Your Sneak Attack Criticals with pistols, revolvers, and submachine guns, whether Guns or Energy Weapons, all inflict an additional 20% damage.
With each rank of Thief perk, you gain an immediate bonus of 5 points to both the Sneak and Lockpick skills.
With the Toughness perk, you gain +3 to overall Damage Threshold. This perk may be taken twice, with the second rank granting an additional +3.
While wearing light armor or no armor, you run 10% faster.
While using Guns and Energy Weapons, you fire 20% more slowly but are 20% more accurate.
Your martial might is truly legendary. You do a large amount of additional damage through enemy blocks with all Melee Weapons and Unarmed attacks.
Waste not, want not. When you use Energy Weapons, you are more likely to recover drained ammunition. You also have more efficient recycling recipes available at the wasteland\'s workbenches.
Weapon Strength Requirements are now 2 points lower than normal for you.

While Cass is a companion, she and the player gain Damage Threshold when they drink Whiskey. Additionally, the player does not suffer intelligence loss from consuming alcohol and ignores the negative effects of alcohol addiction.
Wild Wasteland unleashes the most bizarre and silly elements of post-apocalyptic America. Not for the faint of heart or the serious of temperament.

"BUILDING A DECK Caravan decks are comprised of at least 30 cards from one or more traditional playing card sets. The deck may have any number of cards of any type that suits a player's strategy, although it cannot have duplicate cards from the same set. For example, a King of Spades from Set A and a King of Spades from the Set B deck is acceptable, but more than one King of Spades from Set A would be illegal.
RULES Caravan is played with two players building three opposing piles (or "caravans") of numbered cards. The goal is to outbid your opponent's caravan with the highest value of numbered cards without being too light (under 21) or overburdened (over 26).
The game begins with each player taking eight cards from their deck and placing either one numerical card or ace on each caravan. Players may not discard during this initial round.
Once both players have started their three caravans, each player may do ONE of the following on their turn: 1. Play one card and draw a new card from his or her deck to their hand. 2. Discard one card from their hand and draw a new card from his or her deck. 3. Disband one of their three caravans by removing all cards from that pile.
Caravans have a direction, either ascending or descending numerically, and a suit. The suit is determined with the first card placed on a caravan, the direction by the second. All subsequent cards must continue the numerical direction or match the suit of the previous card. Cards of the same numerical value cannot be played in sequence, regardless of suit. Face cards can be attached to numeric cards in any caravan and affects them in various ways.
CARD VALUES Joker: Played against ace, 2-10. Effects change based on whether it's an ace or a numbered card (see below). Multiple jokers may be played on the same card.
Ace: Value of 1. Jokers played on aces remove all other non-face cards of the ace's suit from the table. E.g. a joker played on an Ace of Spades removes all spades (except face cards and that card, specifically) from the table.
2-10: Listed value. Jokers played on these cards remove all other cards of this value from the table. E.g. a joker played on a 4 of Hearts removes all 4s (other than that card, specifically) from the table.
Jack: Played against ace, 2-10. Removes that card, along with any face cards attached to it.
Queen: Played against ace, 2-10. Reverses the current direction of the hand and changes the current suit of the hand. Multiple queens may be played on the same card.
King: Played against ace, 2-10. Adds the value of that card again. E.g. a king played on a 9 adds 9 to that hand. Multiple kings may be played on the same card for multiplicative effects. E.g. 4+ king = 8. 4 + 2 kings = 16.
WINNING A player's caravan is considered sold when the value of its cards is over 20 and under 27. The other player may still outbid by increasing the value of their opposing pile while staying within the 21-26 range. When each of the three competing caravans has sold, the game is over. In the event that one of the three caravan values are tied between players, the game continues until all three caravans have sold. The player with two or more sales wins the pot."

"----- Whats New with PipDroid v2.0.12 -----
- IMPLEMENTED TUTORIAL SCREEN Due to mass demand, PipDroid now includes a tutorial menu, introducing the APP, presenting new features, and explaining how to navigate and use the APP.
- FACTION REPUTATION MODIFICATION You can now modify your reputation level with all factions inside the APP. Simply press and hold the name of the faction once selected, and watch the reputation level change between the different options.
- MENU CHANGE VARIETY You can now change between different menus in more ways. Simply swiping the top title menu either left or right will switch between the different menus (STATS, ITEMS and DATA) "

" - FULL SCREEN GOODNESS The APP can now be run in true full screen, hiding both the notification bar and the navigation buttons, allowing for a more immersive experience. This new feature can be found in the SETTINGS.
- PERKS AND ITEMS CUSTOMIZATION Perks and ITEMS (Weapons, Apparel, Aid, etc.) can now be customized, such that you can choose from all of the Perks and ITEMS available in the game, and add/show the ones you want, adding an even more personalized experience. The Weapons and Apparel sub-menus also allow "equipping" where you can press and hold the name of an ITEM and "equip" it. The logic of "equipping" follows that of the games, where you can have a weapon and a throwable, or a hat and armour. "

"---------- STATS ----------
----- STATUS ----- Here you can see your character's basic information - Player Name - Player Level - Health - Number of Stimpaks - Etc.
If you press and hold a health container for 1 second or longer, it will hurt your character. Get hurt enough and you'll see the typical damage expressions In order to recover health, simply press the Stimpak button and recover damage "

" It's also on this submenu where you can find the RAD and EFF menus, where you can see your current RAD levels and status effects.
----- S.P.E.C.I.A.L. ----- Here you can find all of the classic S.P.E.C.I.A.L. values from the games.
These values can be edited. Simply select a S.P.E.C.I.A.L. item, press and hold the name of the item, and watch the value increase and decrease. The values you modify will be saved in the APP, so that your character will always have the values you configure. "

" ----- SKILLS ----- Here you can find the SKILLS from both Fallout 3 and Fallout New Vegas.
These values can be edited. Just like the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. values, simply press and hold the name of a SKILL, and watch the value increase and decrease. The longer you press and hold the item, the faster the value will increase.
----- PERKS ----- Here you can find some of the PERKS from the games.
PERKS are now configurable, such that each player can set their own PERKS from a vast list of PERKS from the games. To select the PERKS, simply press and hold the PERKS sub-menu button until the Filter menu pops-up. You can then search for specific PERK names, SELECT ALL or CLEAR ALL, and save. Once you close the Filter, the new PERKS will show up dynamically.
----- GENERAL ----- Here you can find the factions from the games.
These values can be edited. Once you select a faction, you will see their icon, and your reputation with that faction. Press and hold a faction name for the reputation to change from the different options (Idolized, Liked, Accepted, Neutral, Shunned, Hated, Vilified) "
" It is here too where you can find the SETTINGS menu, to change between the different MENUs (STATS, ITEMS, DATA)"

"---------- ITEMS ----------
----- WEAPONS, APPAREL, AID, MISC, AMMO ----- Here you can find some of the classic items from the games.
Currently, these entries are static, and are just for show.
ITEMS are now configurable, such that each player can set their own Weapons, Apparel, Aid, Misc and Ammo from a vast list of ITEMS from the games. To select the ITEMS, simply press and hold the corresponding sub-menu button (Weapons, Apparel, Aid, etc.) until the Filter menu pops-up. You can then search for specific Weapons, Apparel, etc. names, SELECT ALL or CLEAR ALL, and save. Once you close the Filter, the new ITEMS will show up dynamically. "

" The Weapons and Apparel sub-menus also allow "equipping" where you can press and hold the name of an ITEM and "equip" it. The logic of "equipping" follows that of the games, where you can have a weapon and a throwable, or a hat and armour. "

"---------- DATA ----------
----- LOCAL MAP ----- On this menu, you can find a map of the earth.
** Stay tuned for future updates, where there will be little easter eggs added to different key points on the map.
----- WORLD MAP ----- Here you can find the World Maps from both Fallout 3 and Fallout New Vegas.
Featuring all key locations from both games, you can zoom in and see both key location icons and names.
----- QUESTS ----- Here you can find some of the key quests from the games.
** Stay tuned for future updates, where even more quests will be added, and will be editable for you to choose which quest to work on / are pending or not.
----- MISC ----- Here you can find some of the Notes and Holotapes from around the Wasteland.
** Stay tuned for future updates, where even more Notes and Holotapes will be added, and special Holotapes will be implemented.
----- RADIO ----- On this menu you can find music from some of the radio stations from the Wasteland.
You can also choose to listen to your own local music from inside the APP. There is also an option to use PipDroid as a Bed-side clock, using the Clock menu."

"---------- SETTINGS ----------
----- PLAYER NAME ----- Set your players name (16 character limit)
----- PLAYER LEVEL ----- Set your players level (3 digit limit)
----- C. RADIO MP3 FOLDER ----- In order to use the Custom radio, you must choose a folder on your phone where your MP3 files are saved. On Android phones, this is typically 'Music' (Internally saved as '/storage/0/Music'). If you had all your MP3 files in your Downloads folder for example, this value could be 'Download'
----- SCREEN RESIZE ----- For those of you who wish to use this APP with the PipBoy 3000 from The Fallout 4 Special Edition, you can use this option to set the size of the interface to fit inside of the screen Once you have selected this option, you can choose the resize button to enter editing mode and adjust both size (pinching action) and location (single finger moving). Simply press the resize button again to exit editing mode. "

" ----- WORLD MAP SCALING ----- Due to every phone having different screen sizes and resolutions sometimes the world map icons don't show up in the correct locations. To fix this, we've added a simple scaling value just simply modify this value until the locations appear in the correct spots. The following are some example values:
- Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra (Resolution 2316x1080) --- 0.9347
- Samsung Galaxy J3(6) (Resolution 1280x720) --- 0.663
- Blackberry Passport (Resolution 1440x1440) --- 1.0
----- DATE FORMATS ----- You can modify the Date format shown on the DATA menus from the different options available.
- MM/DD/YY - MM/DD/YYYY - DD/MM/YY - DD/MM/YYYY - YYYY/MM/DD
----- UI COLOUR ----- Here you can change the interface colour from different options available in the games.

----- ENABLE TRUE FULLSCREEN ----- This option hides both the notification bar and the navegation buttons, allowing for a more immersive / fullscreen experience.
----- SHOW TUTORIAL AT START ----- This checkbox indicates whether this tutorial should be shown when the APP is loaded or not.
----- BLUETOOTH SETUP ----- Here you can configure external devices to connect with PipDroid using Bluetooth (ESP32 S3 mini board for example).
For this, you must first configure: - MAC Address of the Bluetooth device - Service UUID - Read UUID - Write UUID
